_comment: TESTNET-PUBLIC-BETA-LAUNCH-KIT-V1 — minimal seed set for the public Base Sepolia beta. Feed to scripts/seed-options-series.mjs. The backend's POST /options/series endpoint computes a deterministic option_series_id from (underlying, strike, expiry, is_call, base/quote/settlement asset), so re-running this seed against the same DB is idempotent.
_underlying_oracle_caveat: These series are TESTNET BETA placeholders. The strike + expiry combinations are illustrative; before public launch the operator should sanity-check that the on-chain OptionProductRegistry recognises the same products. The mock collateral on Base Sepolia is USDC-denominated.
